description: Propose a change to a note and show the diff. This does NOT write anything. It returns a proposal id, which apply_edit takes to write the change. Show the user the diff and let them decide before calling apply_edit. Prefer `edits`: each one quotes a short passage from the note in `find` (a line or two, copied exactly, enough to match only once) and gives its replacement in `replace`. To insert, quote the passage the new text goes after and repeat it at the start of `replace`. To add to the end, leave `find` empty. Send `markdown` (the COMPLETE new note body) only when rewriting most of the note. Never use em dashes or en dashes in anything written to a note. Use a period, colon, comma, or parentheses instead. Ordinary hyphens in compound words and numeric ranges are fine.

edits.description: Changes applied in order, each to the result of the one before.

find.description: A passage copied exactly from the note, matching it only once. Empty to add to the end.

replace.description: What the passage becomes, in the same Markdown the note uses. Empty to delete it.

markdown.description: The complete new note body in Markdown. Not a fragment or a patch. Supported: headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, code fences, links, images, blockquotes, callouts (a blockquote opening with [!NOTE], [!TIP] or [!WARNING]), bulleted and numbered lists, task lists, tables, --- rules, ==highlight== (a coloured one is <mark data-color="purple">words</mark>: keep the tag and its colour), sticky notes (<!-- sticky -->, the quoted words, <!-- /sticky -->), and tabs (<!-- tabs -->, then <!-- tab: Title --> before each tab's content, then <!-- /tabs -->). Anything else is flattened. A line that is nothing but a link to /api/uploads/... IS AN ATTACHED FILE, not a reference to one: reproduce it exactly, alone on its own line, to keep it where it is. A file cannot be removed this way: if its line is dropped, the file is kept and moved to the end of the note.

note_id.description: Note id, as returned by search_notes or list_notes.

summary.description: One short sentence describing the change, shown above the diff.

name: scratchpad_propose_edit
title: Propose edit
